dossier.orientation: Scribe is software that records the steps of work done in apps and turns them into step-by-step how-to guides, which an IT team could use instead of keeping procedures in individual heads.

setup_conditions: Use Scribe in the browser on the free Basic plan to generate how-to guides (E1)
Capturing desktop application processes requires a Pro or Enterprise account; it is not available on Basic (E5)
Plans sit at the team level, so a shared team workspace must be on one tier (E7, E6)
decision_gaps: Does Scribe's documentation state which plans include Autocapture and whether captured steps include screenshots on the free Basic plan?
Does Scribe document a mechanism that flags or updates an existing guide when the underlying application changes?
Step captures include screenshots of each step

unverified_requirement_basis.Captured procedures are usable as struct: "reused as training or as structured context for internal AI tools"

defining_need_fit.caveat: The selected evidence documents automatic capture of already-performed work into guides (E12) but states nothing about screenshots per step, re-capture when a system changes, or an AI-context output format, and desktop-app capture is gated to Pro/Enterprise (E5).
defining_need_fit.why: Only the capture-and-generate component of the stated need is supported by selected evidence; the currency and AI-context components are not established by it.

first_email_scope.request: Write exactly one email. Introduce our product to a new buyer with one clear next step.
first_email_scope.workflow: On the free Basic plan, the buyer can create an account and use Scribe in the browser to record one browser-based IT procedure and generate a shareable step-by-step how-to guide from it, with sensitive data redacted automatically.
setup_conditions: Requires a Scribe Basic account, which is free (E1)
Basic is browser-only: capturing processes in desktop applications is a Pro and Enterprise feature (E5)
Plans sit at the team level, so extending beyond one person later means upgrading a team or creating a separate team (E6, E7)
excluded_promises: No claim that this scales documentation across the whole team or organisation
No claim that guides stay current when systems change
No claim of zero disruption to current ticket or wiki practices
No claim of headcount reduction or of replacing an incumbent documentation tool
No claim of time saved, fewer mistakes, or improved AI agent performance for this buyer

ranked_relevance.why: Autocapture is the documented mechanism that turns already-performed work into guides, which is the core of this buyer's stated capture task.
The free Basic plan licenses an in-browser how-to-guide generation path, which is the only entitlement-clear next step for a new buyer.
Desktop capture is Pro/Enterprise only, a condition that must travel with any claim about documenting software setup or system configs.
Automatic redaction of 150 categories of PII, PHI and PCI describes how capture behaves on sensitive IT screens.
States the redaction behaviour of Capture itself, backing the claim that workflows can be recorded without manual scrubbing.
SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, FERPA and GDPR compliance plus fine-grained workspace permissions are the trust facts an internal IT function will check first.
A named enterprise customer's statement about documenting a process is the closest proof point to this buyer's task.
The 12x faster documentation figure is an unattributed Pro Team/Enterprise survey aggregate and overstates what a free first-guide draft can promise.
Pro Team pricing from 5 seats is the eventual team path but is not part of the free first action and should not be appended to it.

problem_fits.caveat: Autocapture documents turning performed work into guides, but the problem evidence is a single 2019 forum thread about tech-company meetings and nothing in the ledger shows tribal knowledge being durably converted or maintained.
problem_fits.why: The product has a documented mechanism that produces written procedures from work already done, which addresses part of undocumented tribal knowledge without proving the outcome.

segment_objections.objection: Most of our procedures involve desktop tools and system configuration, not just browser apps, so a browser-only trial will not cover our real work.
segment_objections.answer: Capture in the browser and guide generation are available on the free Basic plan, while capturing desktop application processes requires a Pro or Enterprise account.

segment_objections.objection: We cannot roll this out to a few people first if licensing forces the whole team onto one tier.
segment_objections.answer: All plans sit at the team level so a team must be on one tier, and upgrading upgrades teammates unless a separate team is created with only the members who need Pro.
